notes: Reviewed against the contract and returned unchanged: no unit's membership, status or head was altered. Two notes were expanded to cite the rules that were checked (s004 on rule 74's supplied subject, s008 on rule 88's expressed-conjunction carve-out, s011 on the particle precedent); no analysis changed.

Every s### and t### id is used exactly once; no ids invented. All twelve units are aligned with nonempty arrays and heads inside them, so rules 3-6 are satisfied and no unrepresented or added unit arises.

Both participles get identical treatment (when + supplied subject + auxiliary or copula on the participle) per rule 24, and both head on the lexical participle rather than on hath or is. Rule 86 licenses the supplied when in both: the participle is the source token carrying the subordination, so nothing here is added.
No article is left unrepresented: both ἡ tokens have an English the of their own, and no possessive or demonstrative competes for the slot, so rules 20, 38 and 49 do not reach this verse.

The one live head question is s011. bringeth was kept over forth because ἀποκυέω is glossed bring forth as a whole and bring is not an empty support verb of the make known / bear witness kind; the same lemma at JAS.1.18 should be headed on the verb word for consistency if that verse is aligned later.
δέ takes t010 and the second article takes t011 across the ASV's order; rule 15 covers the crossing and rule 26 keeps the article off its noun.
